notes.title: In the game, how strong must one be to spar with our invincible protagonist?
notes.content:
[p]Anyone who has tried our [i]Psychic Kung Fu Master[/i] knows this already—
our main character, “Big Shrimp,” starts the journey with a hundred years of inner power, completely maxed out.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]So who on earth could actually stand against such an invincible hero?[/p][/*][/list][p]From the moment Big Shrimp shows up, he’s already at his peak. In Niu Family Village, it’s simple: whoever he meets, he defeats.
From street thugs all the way up to the number one fighter on the “Good Jade Ranking,” he just crushes them all.
Even the strongest opponents usually can’t survive more than three moves.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291904/22fe67cf736024b703eea10bbddc3f212640f94e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Then some friends asked, “Hey Jin, in the early or mid-game, are there any real opponents who can actually fight the hero?”[/p][p]Yes, brother, there are![/p][p]The first one who can truly put up a fight is the Beggar Sect leader—
the famous [b]Xiao… Yun Xianglong[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291904/06953d2f0433aa9200f89c23144aea4bb4a88d4f.png"][/img][/p][p]As a real combat-type master, Yun Xianglong is almost unbeatable at his level.
He has the physique of a “Warlord”—the lower his HP, the harder he hits.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291904/48160c71ead531ba7e7869b260c27b459754214b.png"][/img]
And on top of that, he’s got two health bars. In any other game, he’d easily be a major boss.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291904/6c0c6ef73dc5604de82f5ed5a7d247765f9ae874.png"][/img][/p][p]He’s one of the few who can actually duel with the protagonist. On [i]Grandmaster[/i] difficulty,
if you haven’t learned a couple of strong moves from your sect,
you might not even be able to defeat this “war god incarnate.”[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291904/f8b6d0c8bbcadb7a2669513f072cbe5f97bc545d.png"][/img][/p][p]And as the game continues, even tougher opponents appear.[/p][p]For example, these three old men:[/p][list][*][p][b]Sword Demon – Wu Chen[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Sword Saint – Yue Que[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Sword God – Li Gou’er[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291904/64be9fb766d3472611334ad656635971abad0186.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]When they were young, all three once claimed the title of “strongest under heaven.”
But when they challenged the hero’s master, [i]Qian Yuanzi[/i], they were defeated without effort.[/p][p]Realizing they couldn’t win alone, they stuck together and spent decades training a three-on-one sword formation.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291904/bd9a6089ff14d4ea555b55681e565c388e7e4aad.png"][/img][/p][p]By the time they finally mastered it and came out again, the hero’s master had already died of old age—
but he had passed his full power on to his disciple, the protagonist.[/p][p]So what could they do?
If they couldn’t beat the master, they’d go after the student.
The three of them attack together, surrounding the hero.[/p][h3]Each of them alone is already on par with the Beggar Sect leader Yun Xianglong.
[b]Together, with their sword formation, their power multiplies.[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291904/95fdccf79a2e88fb10db3dc0c11aab657d2e4db6.png"][/img][/p][p]So for the hero, it’s basically like fighting [b]six Yun Xianglongs[/b] at once.
That’s when the real challenge begins to show.[/p][p][/p][p]In [i]Psychic Kung Fu Master[/i], battles aren’t just about moving pieces on a grid.[/p][h3]
[b]Formations, terrain, and other elements gradually come into play as the story goes deeper.[/b][/h3][p]
While you enjoy the thrill of being unstoppable, you’ll also get the real fun of tactical gameplay.[/p][p]And of course, this is still a wuxia game—so story always comes first!
If you’re interested, you can add it to your wishlist, or try the free demo right now.[/p]

notes.title: Think it's ugly? We'll change it!
notes.content: [p]Last week, 'Psychic Kung Fu Master' held its first public beta test and received lots of player feedback.[/p][p] We've carefully reviewed all of it and prioritized optimizations based on the volume of feedback for each issue.[/p][p][/p][p]First and foremost, addressing the most frequently mentioned complaint about the character art being unattractive - we're already working on improving the character illustrations.[/p][p][/p][p]Before & After: Character Art Optimization Comparison[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291904/60ae915db83886d924c46b9825554d8139140c0f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291904/2f0022159b68c5191d3810fc9b51a807d4260e34.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291904/b32875cbc71f003708828fefd69f5da109596c44.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We also received feedback about the time limit system - some players enjoy the realism, while others prefer not to feel pressured by time constraints.[/p][p][/p][p]We've added a toggle in the game settings to turn the time progression on or off. Players who like real-time passage can keep it enabled, while those who want less pressure can disable it.[/p][p][/p][p]Of course, we're also working on other improvements based on feedback, including text revisions and hunting animations, but I won't go into detail here.[/p][p][/p][p]At JinShiSI Studio, our goal has always been to deliver a fun and carefree gaming experience.[/p][p]Listening to player feedback isn't hard.[/p][p]We hope we can live up to that promise.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 'Psychic Kung Fu Master' Test Time, FAQ, and Some Content Leaks
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291904/2f6edcb437daa035e9b8ad0a28707f9fff6f6392.png[/img]

[h2][b]FAQ:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Regarding the Test Version
[/list]
Many players have questioned the test version, thinking it’s an Early Access (EA) version. Let me clarify: Psychic Kung Fu Master's test version is not an EA version, it’s a Playtest version.
The goal of the playtest is to establish the game's tone, evaluate the art style, and check the overall presentation. We will make additions, adjustments, and improvements based on your feedback.

[list]
[*]  Regarding the Test and Demo Time
[/list]
Many players have been asking about the test period, but I’ve hesitated to provide an answer. The original schedule was before the New Year, but after receiving valuable feedback, we decided to rework some resources to improve the overall quality of the game, which caused a delay.
Due to time and personnel limitations, the early test version may not showcase all content.
We will optimize features based on priority, and we truly appreciate the patience of everyone waiting.
The test version is now expected around mid-March. Apologies for the delay!
[list]
[*]  Regarding the Mobile Version
[/list]
Some players have asked if there will be a mobile version. The initial release of Psychic Kung Fu Master will be on the PC version via Steam. There is no mobile version currently available.

[previewyoutube=tOwXPoqOuEg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Leaks:[/b][/h2]
Worldview and Setting:

One of the major factions in Psychic Kung Fu Master is the Dragon Cult (豢龙会).
The Dragon Cult is formed by officials from the wealthy regions of Jiangnan, 
who come together under the leadership of Prince Fu. They have created two groups: one called the Donglin Scholars' Association (东林儒生会), made up of Jiangnan's clans. 
They control the nation's economic lifeblood, financial power, and half of the officials in the court.
In the Jianghu,
 they joined forces with Fang Tieshan to form a faction that consolidates power by controlling local warlords and executing tasks such as assassinations, robberies, and intelligence gathering. This unified force is known as the Dragon Cult.

The Dragon Cult controls dozens of smaller factions in various industries, such as shipping, martial arts schools, escort agencies, bandit leaders, and intelligence organizations. 
The martial arts skills in these factions are diverse and varied. 
They also control numerous officials and some military forces in the court, creating a complex and intricate power structure.

In addition to the Dragon Sect, there are a dozen or so neutral factions that, due to regional or factional issues, are unwilling to have any dealings with the court.

Character Card: Fang Tieshan (Character art not yet released)

[b]Fang Tieshan Introduction:[/b]
Fang Tieshan is the heir to the Fang Xin Martial Arts School. He was originally just an apprentice but, due to his extraordinary martial arts talent, he rose from basic techniques to the highest level of mastery.
Later, he improved the martial arts techniques of his school, advancing even further.

After reaching the top level of martial arts, Fang Tieshan gained fame, and his martial arts schools spread across the land, quietly positioning themselves as one of the most powerful schools in the Central Plains.

Though his reputation as a hero precedes him, his true desire is for power.
He collaborated with the Donglin Scholars' Association and formed the Dragon Cult with the intention of overthrowing the emperor and taking the throne for himself.

[b]Worldview Details:[/b]
Due to the vast world and detailed information, if players are interested in the world-building,
 feel free to leave a comment, and I will share more detailed faction settings next time.
If there's anything specific you'd like to see, feel free to suggest, and I’ll do my best to accommodate!

notes.title: today sharing some new character designs and game activities.
notes.content:
Greetings, heroes!
The test version is about to go live, and today we’re sharing some new character designs and game activities.
If you’re interested, please add the game to your Steam wishlist. Thank you all for your support!

[list]
[*] [h1][b]Q&A Section[/b][/h1]
[/list]

Can I build a harem?
Absolutely, that goes without saying!

Can there be more characters to romance?
Our game offers unparalleled freedom—not only can you romance multiple characters, but even NPCs, like the vegetable vendor, are fair game!

Some players want to venture alone, while others prefer companions.
The martial arts world belongs to everyone. It’s your journey, your rules. In Psychic Kung Fu Master, you can travel with companions or fight solo.

Will there be any "cheating" plots?
Rest assured, absolutely not. We understand how frustrating that kind of story can be, and it’s something we avoid completely.

What about the variety of martial arts for the protagonist?
That’s a must-have! Our game is all about one thing—thrill! Just like in our trailer, everything is designed to be as satisfying as possible for players!

We highly value your feedback and will continue selecting the most frequently asked questions for regular updates. Thank you for your support!

[list]
[*] [h1][b]Spoiler Alert:[/b][/h1]
[/list]
Let’s start with showcasing the female characters. Once the test version is live, there will be even more reveals.

The morality of the martial arts world is in your hands. May you achieve your dreams of justice and vengeance as you roam the world in Psychic Kung Fu Master!
